32VALP-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    +GND18+GND23+GND4+GND12+GND33+GND19+GND15+GND13+GND32+GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    +Battery + · BiBoard BAT+
    GNDBattery - · BiBoard BAT-
    GNDJ0 GND · BiBoard 18-
    18+J0 V+ · BiBoard 18+
    SERVO_J0J0 SIG · BiBoard 18
    GNDJ8 GND · BiBoard 23-
    23+J8 V+ · BiBoard 23+
    SERVO_J8J8 SIG · BiBoard 23
    GNDJ9 GND · BiBoard 4-
    4+J9 V+ · BiBoard 4+
    SERVO_J9J9 SIG · BiBoard 4
    GNDJ10 GND · BiBoard 12-
    12+J10 V+ · BiBoard 12+
    SERVO_J10J10 SIG · BiBoard 12
    GNDJ11 GND · BiBoard 33-
    33+J11 V+ · BiBoard 33+
    SERVO_J11J11 SIG · BiBoard 33
    GNDJ12 GND · BiBoard 19-
    19+J12 V+ · BiBoard 19+
    SERVO_J12J12 SIG · BiBoard 19
    GNDJ13 GND · BiBoard 15-
    15+J13 V+ · BiBoard 15+
    SERVO_J13J13 SIG · BiBoard 15
    GNDJ14 GND · BiBoard 13-
    13+J14 V+ · BiBoard 13+
    SERVO_J14J14 SIG · BiBoard 13
    GNDJ15 GND · BiBoard 32-
    32+J15 V+ · BiBoard 32+
    SERVO_J15J15 SIG · BiBoard 32
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
33VALP-WIRE-1

Valp is built

Valp is an OpenCat quadruped built from Petoi's Bittle X kit: nine servos, an ESP32 BiBoard V1 with its own IMU, and a 2S Li-ion pack. This package checks the wiring of every servo to the socket OpenCatEsp32 expects, gives a joint test you run before the legs go on, and hands over to Petoi's firmware and calibrator for standing and walking.
